scenarios.purpose: Establish repeatable reference performance for a declared wash task and item/load set.
hard_gates: reference identity and test procedure are reproducible
meter boundary and calibration are declared
failed and repeated tasks remain in the data
no missing required measure is silently replaced
adversarial_controls: compare only faucet nameplate flow
change load or soil between trials
omit rewashes or invalid runs
scenarios.claim_limit: A reference baseline does not show superiority or prove hygienic safety.

scenarios.purpose: Compare usability and task outcomes across declared lower-than-nominal supply pressure.
conditions_to_freeze: low/nominal/high pressure points and measurement method
hard_gates: pressure is measured throughout or sampling limitations are declared
lower pressure does not excuse a failed endpoint
limits and tested interval are explicit
adversarial_controls: assume pressure from building type
report rated flow without measured pressure
drop failed trials
scenarios.claim_limit: Only supports the tested pressure range and task; it is not a guarantee for all low-pressure systems.

scenarios.purpose: Compare stream/spray/default/high-flow controls by total task completion rather than litres per minute.
hard_gates: all consumed water is accounted for
mode-switch and accidental-activation observations are recorded
cleaning endpoint is matched across candidates
adversarial_controls: credit only steady-state faucet litres per minute
exclude user correction or rewash
ignore failure to return to efficient default
scenarios.claim_limit: A flow mode is not superior unless whole-task outcomes and cleaning endpoints support it.

scenarios.purpose: Compare splash deposition under a standardized, safe fluorescent tracer protocol.
conditions_to_freeze: pressure, flow, stream mode and impact point
number of repeats and cleaning between trials
hard_gates: receiver locations are frozen before comparison
cleaning of the fixture and receivers between trials is recorded
measurement method is identical across designs
adversarial_controls: count only visible front splash
move sensitive receivers after seeing results
equate fluorescent tracer deposition with pathogen transfer
scenarios.claim_limit: Tracer deposition is a comparative proxy, not a pathogen or illness-risk measurement.

scenarios.purpose: Test whether removable inserts drain, remain inspectable and can be cleaned without residue traps.
hard_gates: seams and underside are inspected
cleaning is performed as specified
insert switching is not counted as sanitation
food-contact suitability remains a separate documented gate
adversarial_controls: inspect only visible top surfaces
treat color coding as a hygiene barrier
ignore trapped water or hard-to-reach joints
scenarios.claim_limit: Visual or tracer observations do not establish microbial safety or food-contact regulatory compliance.

scenarios.purpose: Establish passive-rack drying performance under fixed ambient conditions and a declared item set.
conditions_to_freeze: item types and starting water load
hard_gates: endpoint and stability tolerance are declared before trials
item type and rack position are retained in results
ambient conditions are measured
empty rack capacity is not substituted for loaded capacity
adversarial_controls: decide dryness by appearance alone
change room RH without recording it
ignore cups or cutlery that dry slower than plates
scenarios.claim_limit: Dryness endpoint does not establish sanitization or pathogen removal.

scenarios.purpose: Detect item- and position-specific failure across a standardized loaded set.
hard_gates: every item is tracked
slowest subgroup remains visible in reporting
loaded configuration is reproducible
adversarial_controls: report only average dry time
omit hard-to-place items
change item mix to inflate capacity
scenarios.claim_limit: Performance applies only to the tested loaded set and defined conditions.

scenarios.purpose: Determine whether optional assisted airflow provides a worthwhile drying benefit without unacceptable cost or contamination transfer.
hard_gates: passive and assisted variants use matched conditions
dirty drain air is not intentionally routed over clean items
no sanitization claim is inferred from airflow/heat
electrical and ingress-safety review remains separate
adversarial_controls: claim energy efficiency without measuring energy
use heat or UV as assumed sanitization
ignore noise, aerosol/deposition or local hot spots
scenarios.claim_limit: Only validates measured drying/energy trade-offs under the declared setup; no microbial or regulatory claim.

scenarios.purpose: Verify repairability through successful service and functional post-checks.
hard_gates: local plumbing/electrical qualification requirements are respected
post-checks pass before declaring success
installed part and revision are recorded
adversarial_controls: count parts installed instead of verified repair
omit slow/failed service attempts
ignore leak or altered flow
scenarios.claim_limit: One successful service event does not establish universal repairability or lifetime parts availability.

scenarios.purpose: Assess reach, grip and task completion for varied user needs and seated/standing postures.
hard_gates: participants can stop without penalty
representative variation is declared
individual observations are not hidden by averages
privacy-preserving data handling is specified
adversarial_controls: recruit only able-bodied expert users
infer accessibility from a rendering
treat user preference as proof of safety
scenarios.claim_limit: A limited usability study cannot establish universal accessibility; report tested user groups and conditions.

scenarios.purpose: Prove that missing, invalid, failed and blocked observations cannot silently improve the comparison.
hard_gates: every expected candidate/profile/metric cell has a value or explicit status
unknown never maps to zero or pass
failed and invalid trials remain auditable
reported aggregates reconcile with raw records
adversarial_controls: replace absent flow with zero
drop difficult candidate/profile combinations
label a skipped run as pass
report a score without denominator
scenarios.claim_limit: Data integrity is necessary for valid comparison but does not itself demonstrate physical performance.

scenarios.purpose: Compare measured-volume batch washing against continuous stream and a declared low-flow setting for an identical household load.
conditions_to_freeze: batch fill volume and wash-stage water
measured pressure, flow and incoming water temperature
safe handling/lift limit for the wash insert
hard_gates: same task endpoint and load across candidates
final rinse uses the separately declared method and is not silently omitted
dirty wash water is never credited as a final rinse
all water consumed by pre-rinse, wash, final rinse and rewash is included
insert fill mass/volume and safe handling are measured
food-service deployment is separately reviewed against applicable requirements
adversarial_controls: compare batch wash on a small load with flowing wash on a larger load
exclude final rinse water from the batch method
change detergent or soil between candidates
reuse dirty water as if it were clean final-rinse water
ignore handling difficulty, spillage, rewashes or load failures
assume domestic method satisfies commercial sanitation requirements
scenarios.claim_limit: Supports only the tested household load, detergent, source-water conditions and defined endpoint; does not establish food-service compliance or universal water savings.

scenarios.purpose: Compare commercial pre-rinse spray valves by task-complete water, adequate spray force/coverage and soil-removal endpoint over a declared pressure envelope.
conditions_to_freeze: initial soil amount and standardized load
trigger duty pattern and task endpoint
hard_gates: pressure is measured under flowing conditions
matched soil/load/geometry and endpoint across candidates
force and coverage are assessed over the declared pressure envelope, not one favorable point
water includes every trigger event and any rerinse
predefined splash receivers remain fixed
applicable commercial plumbing/food-equipment compliance is reviewed separately
adversarial_controls: lower rated flow increases trigger-on time or rerinse volume
central force passes while edge coverage fails
pressure or nozzle distance changes across candidates
a soil class fails while the average hides it
tracer deposition moves onto another sensitive surface
initial performance is reported without post-wear or post-service checks
scenarios.claim_limit: A valve-level and matched-task comparison under declared conditions; not a sanitation, microbial-reduction, certification or universal superiority claim.
